params.prompt: Photoreal high-end food photography, square 1:1, dark warm background (#0B0907). Four desserts in one neat row on a dark wooden pastry counter, seen from a slightly elevated front angle, evenly spaced, equal size: from left to right — three small cupcakes on a plate, a round fruit tart, a tall layered Russian honey cake (medovik) with visible thin layers, and a slice of classic cheesecake. The honey cake is lit with a single warm spotlight and sits slightly forward; the other three are dimmer. Matte surfaces, soft warm rim light, subtle yellow (#FDD506) glow under the honey cake. The upper 40% of the frame is empty dark space for typography. No text, no labels, no logos, no watermark, no hands.
